voiceReference.title: Voice reference
voiceReference.searchPlaceholder: Type a word… e.g. boarding, heading

who.ground: Ground crew answers on INT — say cockpit to ground first, or use the single-shot phrases
who.cabin: The purser answers on CAB — say cockpit to cabin first
who.atc: The FO acknowledges, then transmits on COM1 to SayIntentions ATC
who.checklists: The FO runs the checklist — answer each challenge, or use the always-available words

footer.editTitle: Your own phrases live in commands.json (user config folder)

off.speechFo: {0} is off — Settings → Voice First Officer
off.mcdu: {0} is off — Settings → Voice First Officer → MCDU
off.monitoring: {0} is off — Settings → Voice First Officer → Callouts & Placards → In-flight monitoring
off.sayIntentions: SayIntentions is off — Settings → Voice First Officer → SayIntentions
off.groundCrew: {0} is off — Settings → Voice First Officer → Ground Crew
off.cabinCrew: {0} is off — Settings → Voice First Officer → Cabin Crew
off.foQuestions: {0} is off — Settings → Voice First Officer → Briefings & LLM → Ask the First Officer
off.cruiseQuery: {0} is off — Settings → Voice First Officer → Cabin Crew → Purser cruise query

always.negative: Cancel a pending FCU, radio or MCDU action.

roles.title: Controls handover
roles.handover: Hand the FO the aircraft. Airborne, the FO asks you to confirm first.
roles.takeBack: Take the aircraft back — instant, also aborts any pending FCU or MCDU action.
roles.pmCall: Your pilot-monitoring call while the FO flies.

fcu.title: FCU — while the FO is pilot flying
fcu.heading: Set the heading. The FO reads it back, waits 3 s for 'negative', then sets and verifies.
fcu.flightLevel: Set the altitude as a flight level.
fcu.verticalSpeed: Set V/S. Say 'descend' or 'down' for a descent.
fcu.altitudeMode: Altitude knob pull, push, or EXPED.
fcu.negative: Cancel a pending FCU or radio action inside its 3 s window.

radios.title: Radios
radios.tune: Tune a standby frequency (118.000–136.990); the FO reads it back, then sets and verifies.

engineFlap.title: Engine & flap calls
engineFlap.flapsOne: Placard speed check — nothing is moved.

gear.title: Gear
gear.up: The FO moves the lever — refused on the ground or above the retraction limit.
gear.down: The FO moves the lever — refused above the extension limit.

chrono.title: Takeoff
chrono.takeoff: Starts the FO chrono on the takeoff roll (stops at touchdown).

mcduRead.title: MCDU — read
mcduRead.page: The FO reads the current MCDU page aloud.

mcduRadNav.title: MCDU — ILS
mcduRadNav.tune: The FO tunes the arrival ILS on RAD NAV.

mcduArrival.title: MCDU — arrival runway
mcduArrival.change: The FO changes the arrival runway and ILS (LAT REV → ARRIVAL → insert).

briefings.title: Briefings
briefings.departure: Departure briefing from the FMS plan, navdata and live weather.
briefings.arrival: Arrival briefing — the FO asks you to confirm the minimums first.
briefings.approaches: The navdata approaches for the arrival runway.

minima.title: Minimums
minima.query: The minima you confirmed in the arrival briefing.

company.title: Company
company.loadsheet: Spoken loadsheet from the live weights, pax and CG (ACARS chime).

day.title: Duty day
day.end: Ends it with a summary and the logbook fold.

fuelCheck.title: Fuel check
fuelCheck.check: Fuel on board against the SimBrief plan at your position, and the estimated landing fuel against the planned figure. Also automatic in the cruise.

fuelDecision.title: Fuel decision
fuelDecision.decision: The destination TAF at the ETA against the minima — extra fuel advised, or none.
fuelDecision.extra: Raises the INIT block fuel by minutes of holding or by hundreds of kilos.
fuelDecision.holding: Fuel over the destination minus alternate and final reserve, as minutes of holding.

grossErrorCheck.title: Gross error check
grossErrorCheck.check: The aircraft's weights against the final loadsheet and the FMS PERF entries against the last takeoff performance calculation. Also automatic once the final loadsheet and V-speeds are in.

readbacks.title: Read-backs
readbacks.altimeter: Read back the altimeter setting; the FO checks it against your baro. 'Read back', 'check' or 'confirm' may lead in.
readbacks.standard: Standard pressure set; the FO checks the baro reads 1013.
readbacks.vSpeeds: Read back V1, rotate and V2; the FO checks them against the FMS.
readbacks.runway: Read back the runway; the FO checks it against the FMS plan.
readbacks.minimums: Read back the minimums; the FO checks them against the briefed minima.

techLogDialogue.title: Tech log — raise / rectify
techLogDialogue.raise: Guided: the defect, then the MEL category (bravo, charlie, delta), then confirm.

quiet.title: Quiet
quiet.quiet: Silences chatter for the rest of the session (checklists and callouts still speak).

disregard.title: Disregard
disregard.disregard: Silences the advisory the FO is speaking (aircraft state, parking, dropped call) and acknowledges — with nothing playing, just the acknowledgement.

aircraftState.title: Aircraft state
aircraftState.recheck: Re-runs the cold-and-dark check; the FO reads the verdict.

pushbackDirection.title: Pushback direction
pushbackDirection.tailLeft: This flight's push: GSX's 'Nose Right / Tail Left'. Applied when GSX shows the direction menu.
pushbackDirection.tailRight: This flight's push: GSX's 'Nose Left / Tail Right'.
pushbackDirection.facing: Relay ATC's direction; the FO picks the route that ends facing that way (any of the eight compass points).
pushbackDirection.which: Your choice for this flight, or the FO's suggestion toward the departure runway.

gsx.title: Ground services
gsx.start: Start the departure sequence (or call the next service once it is running).

command.forceNextService: The INT/RAD smart button — call the next service now.
command.confirmFuel: Confirm the block fuel, then order the truck (or a top-up).
command.requestGpu: Connect ground power — GSX's GPU, or the ProSim unit when the stand has none; the ground crew reports it connected.
command.disconnectGpu: Take the ground power unit away (not while EXT PWR still feeds the aircraft).
command.declineDeice: Decline the First Officer's de-icing question — no de-icing this departure.

gsxCabin.title: Boarding
gsxCabin.boarding: Boarding — the FO requests it, the purser confirms.

hailGround.title: Hail the ground crew
hailGround.how: Hail, then say any ground-services phrase in the window.
hailGround.how.gated: Select INT on the audio panel, hail, then say any ground-services phrase in the window.
hailGround.cancel: End the hail without a request.

hailCabin.title: Hail the cabin crew
hailCabin.how: Hail, then ask for boarding in the window.
hailCabin.how.gated: Select CAB on the audio panel, hail, then ask for boarding in the window.

foQuestions.title: Ask the First Officer
foQuestions.fuel: Fuel on board and the planned figures.
foQuestions.weather: The destination METAR as the hero card shows it.
foQuestions.compare: Anything the fact sheet can compare.
foQuestions.leadIn: Any question starting with one of these lead-ins and at least {0} words long. Answered only from live facts; the FO says "{1}" when the facts do not cover it. Needs the LAN speech server.

smallTalk.football: Small talk: general knowledge, in character, no flight figures.
smallTalk.funFact: A fun fact, one or two sentences.
smallTalk.any: Small talk is on: no lead-in needed. A question that mentions the flight still takes the strict, verified path.

whereAreWe.wikipedia: The country, mountains or sea below and the nearest towns — at once, from the built-in atlas — then a fact or two from Wikipedia.
whereAreWe.model: The country, mountains or sea below and the nearest towns — at once, from the built-in atlas — then a fact or two from the model.
whereAreWe.side: Same answer; the side is relative to our track.

cabinCruiseQuery.title: Purser cruise query
cabinCruiseQuery.eta: Once per flight in the cruise the purser calls — "{0}" — and listens {1} s. A time or arrival estimate in your answer:
cabinCruiseQuery.other: Anything else (free answer with the LAN speech server; the offline engine hears a short list):
